description: Search the product catalog. Filter by layer (ground/architecture/plants), text query, or category.

categoryId.description: Category id to filter by. For architecture and ground (flat trees), use any id from get_categories. For plants (two-level tree), this must be a leaf id from get_subcategories(<top-level id>) — top-level plant ids return 0 because plant products are assigned only to leaves. For plant discovery prefer search_plants (attribute filtering); categoryId is most useful for architecture/ground browsing.

query.description: Text search query — matches product name only (the `code` field is NOT searched; if you have a PL00xxx-style code, look it up separately)

name: search_products
